# dsh-family-budget · 家庭财务整理助手

A monthly household budget page for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar entry opens one table
per month with i

ncome, fixed expenses, variable expenses, savings, an emergency fund,
debt and a review block. It ad

ds up what you enter, shows the gaps to your own
savings / debt / down-payment target, and keeps eve

ter, shows the gaps to your own
savings / debt / down-payment target, and keeps every month on disk.

**It is bookkeeping, not advice.** No market data, no products, no forecasts, no
investment suggesti
ons — the page says so itself.
## The monthly table
| Block | What you enter | What the page computes |

| 收入 Income | 工资、奖金、其他进项 | 收入合计，占各比例的基数 |
| 固定支出 Fixed | 房贷／房租、水电燃气、通讯、保险、教育 | 固定支出合计，占收入比例 |
| 可变支出

Variable | 每项的预算与实际 | 预算合计、实际合计、逐项差额、超支项 |
| 储蓄 Savings | 计划储蓄、已累计储蓄 | 本月可存（结余）、距计划差额、一键记入累计 |
| 应急

金 Emergency fund | 现有应急金、目标月数（3/6/12） | 目标金额 = 固定支出 × 月数，覆盖率与缺口 |
| 债务 Debt | 每笔余额、月供、本月已还 | 余额合计、月供

合计、已还合计 |
| 复盘 Review | 做得好的／超支原因／下月调整 | 自动核对：储蓄率、超支项、固定支出占比、应急金覆盖 |

The goal bar switches between **储蓄 / 还债 / 买房** and tracks one target with an
accumulated amount you

## Install
Add it from **Settings → Plugins → Add** with the repository spec:

Or take the prebuilt `dsh-family-budget.tgz` from the
releases page.
Either way, reload the window a

fterwards and open the **家庭财务 / Family budget**
entry in the sidebar.
The package is not on npm, so a bare `dsh-family-budget` name will not resolve.
## Data

- Everything is kept in one document under `<dsh home>/family-budget/budget.json`.
- The Host half v

alidates every write: unknown keys are dropped, amounts are
clamped to non-negative numbers rounded

to cents, month keys must be `YYYY-MM`,
review prose is capped, and an unreadable file is moved asid

e instead of being
overwritten.
- Nothing leaves the machine. The page talks only to its own plugin

route.
- Export CSV for a spreadsheet, export/import JSON for a backup. The import is
confirmed in t
he page before it replaces the document.

Displayed amounts use a `¥` prefix as a formatting convention only; the plugin
does not convert curr

ed amounts use a `¥` prefix as a formatting convention only; the plugin
does not convert currencies.
